nodes.brief:
Dictionaries are repositories mapping words to definitions, etymologies, and usage examples within a language. They preserve semantic precision and document how meaning shifts across historical periods, serving as the arbiter of correct usage that other reference works assume rather than establish.

Within [[09]] Reference & Documentation, dictionaries are the semantic counterpart to [[09.01]] Encyclopedias: where an encyclopedia explains a concept, a dictionary fixes the word for it, and the two are frequently consulted together when a reader meets unfamiliar terminology. Dictionaries also underpin [[09.05]] Standards & Specifications, since a specification's precision depends on terms whose meaning is fixed and shared — a standards body cannot define tolerances on a word that means different things to different readers.

For an authoritative historical dictionary of English, see the [Oxford English Dictionary](https://www.oed.com/), and for a freely available general dictionary, [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/).

nodes.name: Lexicography
nodes.en: The making of dictionaries: what counts as a word, how senses are distinguished, and the corpus evidence behind a definition.
nodes.cs: Tvorba slovníků: co se počítá za slovo, jak se rozlišují významy a jaké korpusové doklady stojí za definicí.

nodes.name: Dictionary Types
nodes.en: Monolingual, bilingual, etymological, technical and learner dictionaries, and the different questions each answers.
nodes.cs: Výkladové, překladové, etymologické, odborné a slovníky pro nerodilé mluvčí a různé otázky, jež každý zodpovídá.

nodes.name: Terminology and Glossaries
nodes.en: Domain-specific term collections, the discipline of defining a term once, and its role in translation and standards.
nodes.cs: Oborové sbírky termínů, kázeň definovat termín jednou a jejich role v překladu a normalizaci.

nodes.name: Machine-Readable Lexicons
nodes.en: Dictionaries as data: structured entries, word lists and lexical databases usable by programs rather than people.
nodes.cs: Slovníky jako data: strukturovaná hesla, seznamy slov a lexikální databáze použitelné programy, nikoli lidmi.
